scope: Read-only unauthenticated public provenance searches; no RPC, contracts, runtime probes, builds, private archives, credentials or publication.

official_docs.audit_claim: Publisher links only to Halborn homepage; no report/revision binding.

name_search_disambiguation.Georgyskr/donation-relayer: README describes Hardhat and Sepolia deployment, not the captured Solana relay.
name_search_disambiguation.asadelkalnash5-ui/donation-relay: No README; complete current tree contains only package.json and relay-server.js, no Rust contract/build inputs.
name_search_disambiguation.other_results: Search metadata identifies a Smash.gg Discord bot and a Giveth Solidity relayer; neither is linked to Donate.gg.

limitations: HTTP404 does not distinguish private, deleted, renamed or inaccessible repository. No redirect observed at embedded URL.
GitHub organization public inventory is current only; empty events response is not full historical activity.
GitHub repository/README, commit-message and issue searches are bounded indexed surfaces, not authenticated global code search.
Wayback queries checked successful indexed repository/raw URLs; empty results do not prove the pages never existed or that every archive lacks them.
Software Heritage origin absence does not prove source/history absence elsewhere; organization search had a positive control.
Auditor catalogs and sitemap slugs are publication discovery surfaces; absence of a matching public report does not disprove a private audit.
IDL version/interface correspondence does not pin Rust source, Cargo.lock, compiler, build flags or deployed artifact provenance.
next_evidence_needed: Publisher-owned source revision or public repository relocation tied to this captured program/deployment.
A published source archive with commit, lockfile, dependencies and build recipe.
A release/build or audit manifest explicitly associating a source commit with this artifact or deployment; then independently verify source build.
stop_reason: No remaining concrete primary-source lead pins a source revision or recipe; no guessed rebuild proposed.
